body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001724034272523452177411999999999999999999999899999999999999…** (70 decimals; the exact value is `kappa` in `research/paired-extension-normal45-rewrites/outer/OUTER-CLAIM.json`, SHA-256 of the decimal string `869742d3e490308fd61beb10221325d6a2d906d571400becd028bb390b128c3e`). The fill is checked to be at the integer optimum of the packing classes for that inventory (the class MILP's idle profile equals the shipped one). New here, by Jeremy Kothe (jeremykothe2), with AI assistance: a declared source-bound stage of fourteen exactness-preserving gate rewrites in five classes (R-retime, A3779 cut-start read, PreloadMove carrier lender entries, B-carrier retimes, and five A-phase commuting swaps with re-solved frames), applied as literal hunks with exact preimages after PR2942's normal-45 overlay stage; the paid local profile, warp positions and cleanup are re-derived, an independent reviewer and 16 semantic tamper controls per word reject every corrupted variant, and the paid profile of the unchanged allocation is re-derived (more rank-4 and fewer rank-1/2/3 mass). Fresh native chains for both words, complete replica admission and the modern outer release are replayed.
